source: The preset adds the derived key rules {0}, {1} and {2}. When {3} is used, {4}, {5} and {6} count as used, and {7} is not reported missing. Suffixes stack, so context with plural ({8}) and ordinal plurals ({9}) also belong to {10}. Hovers and inline values show the {11} form, or another form when the locale has no {12}.
